purpose: Agency exact-freeze tranche across Maldives, North Macedonia and Malta: five directly sourced regulatory, border, public-security, military and detention identities with capacity-limited Schedule boundaries.
migrationRule: An Agency counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Agency dossier. Identity, parent/subordinate hierarchy, mandate, project adjacency and source production never create Material Participation or a governance outcome; direct/partial labels preserve repository source precision honestly.
visualRule: Derived visuals encode State S as context and terminate at the Agency identity boundary. Every evidence card preserves direct versus partial granularity and forbids partOf/control/operation/participation/supplier inference.
